prompt: Give me the simple version: how much acetaminophen (Tylenol) is too much in one day?
reference_facts: For most healthy adults, the commonly cited maximum is 4,000 mg of acetaminophen per day, and many clinicians recommend staying well under that.
Exceeding the daily maximum, especially over several days, risks severe liver damage.
Acetaminophen is included in many combination cold and pain products, so it is easy to accidentally double up without reading labels.
